Key_result: 14003 moving-object candidates.

Notes: Candidate count corrected from pasted estimate.

Title: Optimization Methods for Asteroid Lightcurve Inversion: I. Shape Determination

Key_result: Practical shape inversion framework.

Title: Optimization Methods for Asteroid Lightcurve Inversion: II. The Complete Inverse Problem
Main_question: How can shape spin and period be solved together?
Key_result: Complete photometric inverse problem.
Limitation: Disk-integrated degeneracies.

Title: Phase II of the Small Main-Belt Asteroid Spectroscopic Survey: The Observations
Main_question: What sample supports modern taxonomy?
Key_result: SMASS II observational dataset.
Limitation: Selection and wavelength limits.

Title: Phase II of the Small Main-Belt Asteroid Spectroscopic Survey: A Feature-Based Taxonomy
Main_question: How should SMASS II spectra be grouped?
Key_result: Defines Bus taxonomy.

Title: Efficient Intra- and Inter-night Linking of Asteroid Detections Using kd-trees
Main_question: How can detections be linked efficiently?
Key_result: Demonstrates kd-tree linking.
Limitation: Cadence and tuning dependent.

Title: The Asteroid Lightcurve Database
Authors: Warner BD; Harris AW; Pravec P
Main_question: How can lightcurve properties be consolidated?
Key_result: Describes LCDB.
Limitation: Heterogeneous source quality.

Title: An Extension of the Bus Asteroid Taxonomy into the Near-Infrared
Main_question: How does taxonomy change with NIR?
Key_result: Extends classification to 0.45–2.45 um.
Limitation: Spectral coverage dependent.

Title: Asteroid Models from Combined Sparse and Dense Photometric Data
Main_question: Can sparse data complement dense lightcurves?
Key_result: Demonstrates combined inversion.
Limitation: Sparse-data ambiguities.

Title: DAMIT: A Database of Asteroid Models
Main_question: How can inverted models be shared?
Key_result: Introduces DAMIT.
Limitation: Provenance and uncertainty required.

Title: A Three-Parameter Magnitude Phase Function for Asteroids
Main_question: How can phase behavior be modeled flexibly?
Key_result: Introduces H G1 G2.
Limitation: Needs phase-angle coverage.

Title: Main Belt Asteroids with WISE/NEOWISE. I. Preliminary Albedos and Diameters
Main_question: How can IR data provide diameters and albedos at scale?
Key_result: Over 100000 main-belt physical estimates.
Limitation: Thermal-model and selection assumptions.

Title: Asteroid Rotation Periods from the Palomar Transient Factory Survey
Journal: Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society
Main_question: Can a transient survey recover periods in bulk?
Key_result: 88 high-quality rotation periods.
Limitation: Cadence aliases and photometric limits.

Title: The Pan-STARRS Moving Object Processing System
Journal: Publications of the Astronomical Society of the Pacific
Main_question: How can a survey create discoveries from transient detections?
Key_result: Describes MOPS.
Limitation: Simulation-dependent efficiency claims.

Title: The Taxonomic Distribution of Asteroids from Multi-filter All-sky Photometric Surveys
Main_question: How can survey colors map taxonomy?
Key_result: Connects colors and population inference.
Limitation: Broad-band color ambiguity.

Title: Asteroid Models from the Lowell Photometric Database
Main_question: What models can sparse archives yield?
Key_result: Applies inversion to Lowell data.
Limitation: Reliability and bias challenges.

Title: ATLAS: A High-cadence All-sky Survey System
Journal: Publications of the Astronomical Society of the Pacific
Main_question: What system enables high-cadence all-sky detection?
Key_result: Describes ATLAS.
Limitation: Depth cadence footprint tradeoffs.

Title: DeepStreaks: Identifying Fast-moving Objects in the Zwicky Transient Facility Data with Deep Learning
Journal: Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society
Main_question: Can ML reduce fast-mover screening?
Key_result: CNN deployed in ZTF workflow.
Limitation: Generalization and label bias.

Title: LSST: From Science Drivers to Reference Design and Anticipated Data Products
Main_question: What design and data products define LSST?
Key_result: Documents reference design.
Limitation: Forecast versus on-sky performance.

Title: Asteroid Phase Curves from ATLAS Dual-band Photometry
Main_question: What constraints can ATLAS phase curves deliver?
Key_result: Fits about 95000 asteroids.
Limitation: Cadence and phase-angle constraints.

Title: THOR: An Algorithm for Cadence-independent Asteroid Discovery
Main_question: Can discovery work without tracklets or fixed cadence?
Key_result: Introduces cadence-independent recovery.
Limitation: Test-orbit design and computational cost.

Title: Gaia Data Release 3: The Solar System Survey
Main_question: What Solar-System products does Gaia DR3 provide?
Key_result: Large asteroid astrometry and mean spectra.
Limitation: Scanning-law and selection effects.

Title: Linking the Collisional History of the Main Asteroid Belt to Its Dynamical Excitation and Depletion
Main_question: How are collisional history and dynamical depletion jointly constrained?
Key_result: Combines collisional evolution with dynamical depletion over Solar-System history.
Innovation: Connects belt structure to planetary evolution.
Limitation: Results depend on early-belt dynamical assumptions.

Title: The Yarkovsky and YORP Effects: Implications for Asteroid Dynamics
Authors: Bottke WF; Vokrouhlicky D; Rubincam DP; Nesvorny D
Journal: Annual Review of Earth and Planetary Sciences
Main_question: How do thermal forces and torques alter asteroid evolution?
Key_result: Synthesizes semimajor-axis drift and spin-vector modification.
Innovation: Unifies dynamics collisions families and NEO delivery.
Limitation: Review; quantitative outcomes depend on material and spin inputs.

Title: Yarkovsky/YORP Chronology of Asteroid Families
Main_question: How can thermal evolution date moderately young families?
Key_result: Estimates ages and ejection fields for four families.
Limitation: Age estimates require thermal and initial-ejection assumptions.

Title: Yarkovsky Footprints in the Eos Family
Main_question: How do thermal forces and resonances shape Eos?
Key_result: Explains structure and estimates an age near 1.3 Gyr.
Innovation: Integrates dynamics family membership and composition.
Limitation: Model-dependent age; interlopers and selection effects.

Title: The Breakup of a Main-Belt Asteroid 450 Thousand Years Ago
Authors: Nesvorny D; Vokrouhlicky D; Bottke WF
Main_question: Can a very recent asteroid breakup be identified dynamically?
Key_result: Reports the young Datura family.
Limitation: Limited to sufficiently young compact families.

Title: Density of Asteroids
Main_question: What do measured densities imply about composition and interiors?
Key_result: Compiles 287 small-body mass and volume estimates.
Limitation: Only about one-third of estimates are precise to 20 percent.

Title: Identification and Dynamical Properties of Asteroid Families
Authors: Nesvorny D; Broz M; Carruba V
Main_question: How are families identified and used in dynamical studies?
Key_result: Reviews inventory and supplies memberships for 122 families.
Innovation: Reference gateway for family methods and catalog use.
Limitation: Membership depends on catalog and interloper treatment.

Title: Asteroid Systems: Binaries, Triples, and Pairs
Authors: Margot JL; Pravec P; Taylor P; Carry B; Jacobson S
Main_question: What mechanisms form asteroid binaries triples and pairs?
Key_result: Synthesizes rotational fission for small systems and collisions for large systems.
Innovation: Connects YORP spin-up to system formation.
Limitation: Observational samples and formation channels vary by size regime.

Title: Asteroid Thermophysical Modeling
Authors: Delbo M; Mueller M; Emery JP; Rozitis B; Capria MT
Main_question: What physical parameters can thermal infrared modeling constrain?
Key_result: Relates flux to size albedo inertia roughness shape and spin.
Innovation: Links remote physical characterization and dynamics.
Limitation: Requires assumptions or knowledge of shape spin and surface properties.

Title: Debiased Orbit and Absolute-Magnitude Distributions for Near-Earth Objects
Main_question: What is the debiased NEO distribution and its source mix?
Key_result: Builds a four-dimensional a e i H model calibrated to Catalina detections.
Innovation: Source-specific model including resonances and cometary input.
Limitation: Selection-function and steady-state assumptions.

Title: Reconstruction of Asteroid Spin States from Gaia DR3 Photometry
Main_question: Can sparse Gaia photometry yield unique spin and shape solutions?
Key_result: Finds unique spin states and low-resolution convex models for about 8600 asteroids.
Limitation: Most targets have insufficient points for unique periods.

Title: Asteroid Spin and Shape Properties from Gaia DR3 Photometry
Authors: Cellino A; Tanga P; Muinonen K; Mignard F
Main_question: What spin and shape information can a separate Gaia inversion pipeline recover?
Key_result: Accepts 8670 filtered inversion solutions.
Innovation: Independent large-sample pipeline and reliability filtering.
Limitation: Simple ellipsoid model and limited DR3 sampling.

Title: Asteroid Characterization Using Gaia Data Release 3: I. Shapes Spins and Scattering Properties
Research_topic: Rotation and shape;Photometry and phase functions;Population science
Main_question: Can Gaia DR3 jointly constrain shape spin and scattering?
Key_result: Derives population-scale physical parameters for 8467 asteroids.
Innovation: Joint treatment of shape spin phase slope and absolute magnitude.
Limitation: Sparse cadence and model choice limit parameter identifiability.

Title: Space Weathering from Mercury to the Asteroid Belt
Main_question: How does space weathering alter asteroid spectra?
Key_result: Reviews darkening reddening and weakened absorption bands.
Innovation: Physical entry point for spectral alteration.
Limitation: Mechanisms and rates vary by material and environment.

Title: Space Weathering of Asteroid Surfaces
Journal: Annual Review of Earth and Planetary Sciences
Main_question: Why is observed spectrum not a direct composition proxy?
Key_result: Synthesizes solar-wind and micrometeoroid modification.
Innovation: Connects weathering to S-type and chondrite interpretation.
Limitation: Surface physics remains composition and texture dependent.

Title: Asteroid (216) Kleopatra: Tests of the Radar-derived Shape Model
Main_question: Can a radar-only shape satisfy independent constraints?
Key_result: Finds global agreement but underestimates flattening by about 20 percent.
Limitation: Single target; each modality retains its own systematics.

Title: Fast and Slow Rotation of Asteroids
Main_question: What does the spin-rate distribution imply about asteroid strength?
Key_result: Establishes the roughly 2.2-hour barrier for larger bodies.
Limitation: Historical sample and size estimates are limited.
Notes: Foundation; excluded from main 2001–2026 trend denominator.

Title: Direct Detection of the Asteroidal YORP Effect
Main_question: Can YORP-driven spin change be measured directly?
Key_result: Measures spin acceleration of 2000 PH5.
Innovation: Direct observational validation of asteroidal YORP.
Limitation: Single-object result requires accurate period tracking.

Title: Spin Limits of Solar System Bodies: From the Small Fast-rotators to 2003 EL61
Main_question: How do shape density and strength set spin limits?
Key_result: Derives gravity- and strength-dominated regimes.
Innovation: Extends spin-limit theory to cohesive materials.
Limitation: Material-model assumptions are not direct interior measurements.

Title: Formation of Asteroid Pairs by Rotational Fission
Research_topic: Binary and multiple systems;Yarkovsky and YORP
Main_question: Do asteroid-pair properties support rotational fission?
Key_result: Finds period–mass-ratio relation and no pairs above q about 0.2.
Limitation: Selection effects and multiple formation channels remain.

Title: Main Belt Comets: A New Class of Small Bodies in the Solar System
Main_question: What do main-belt comets imply about asteroid–comet boundaries?
Key_result: Reviews active objects on main-belt-like orbits.
Limitation: Activity mechanisms and population remain incomplete.

Title: The Active Asteroids
Main_question: Which mechanisms drive dust loss from asteroidal orbits?
Key_result: Synthesizes sublimation impact rotation and thermal mechanisms.
Limitation: Small sample and several mechanisms unresolved.

Title: Cohesive Forces Prevent the Rotational Breakup of Rubble-pile Asteroid (29075) 1950 DA
Authors: Rozitis B; MacLennan E; Emery JP
Main_question: Can a fast rubble pile survive with gravity and friction alone?
Key_result: Requires cohesion to prevent shedding and failure for 1950 DA.
Limitation: Inference depends on density shape and thermal-model inputs.

Title: The Active Asteroids
Authors: Jewitt D; Hsieh H; Agarwal J
Main_question: What scientific questions do active asteroids open?
Key_result: Reviews activity as a probe of destruction debris and ice.
Limitation: Heterogeneous mechanisms prevent one population model.

Title: The Main-Belt Comets: The Pan-STARRS1 Perspective
Main_question: How can a wide-field survey identify main-belt comet activity?
Key_result: Analyzes 760475 observations of 333026 main-belt objects.
Innovation: Links PSF morphology screening and survey selection.
Limitation: Estimated efficiency and morphology criteria are survey dependent.

Title: A 2 km-size Asteroid Challenging the Rubble-pile Spin Barrier: A Case for Cohesion
Main_question: Can a kilometre-scale asteroid exceed the rubble-pile barrier?
Key_result: Finds a 1.9529-hour period and argues for cohesion.
Limitation: Interpretation depends on period and size reliability.

Title: The Main Belt Comets and Ice in the Solar System
Research_topic: Active asteroids and main-belt comets;Surface evolution
Main_question: What evidence supports buried ice in the asteroid belt?
Key_result: Reviews MBC observations ice survival and detection methods.
Innovation: Connects active asteroids to volatile distribution.
Limitation: Direct detection of escaping water remains difficult.

Title: Thermophysical Properties of the Surface of Asteroid 162173 Ryugu: Infrared Observations and Thermal Inertia Mapping
Main_question: How do resolved thermal data constrain Ryugu's surface?
Key_result: Reports global thermal inertia 225 plus or minus 45 SI units.
Innovation: In-situ validation of porous-boulder thermal behavior.
Limitation: Single target and model-dependent roughness treatment.

Title: Statistical Ranging of Asteroid Orbits
Authors: Virtanen J; Muinonen K; Bowell E
Main_question: Which orbits remain plausible for a very short observational arc?
Key_result: Samples a Bayesian orbital probability distribution from sparse astrometry.
Innovation: Rigorous Monte Carlo treatment of range uncertainty.
Limitation: Sampling cost and posterior structure depend on observational arc and priors.

Title: The Asteroid Identification Problem IV: Attributions
Authors: Milani A; Sansaturio ME; Chesley SR
Main_question: Can a short arc be assigned reliably to an existing orbit?
Key_result: Reports 1675 attributions in a one-year operational experiment.
Innovation: Combines attributable comparison covariance filtering and differential correction.
Limitation: Requires sufficiently accurate predictions and careful false-match control.
Notes: Use for attribution, not discovery linking.

Title: Orbit Determination with Topocentric Correction: Algorithms for the Next Generation Surveys
Authors: Milani A; Gronchi GF; Farnocchia D; et al.
Main_question: How can initial orbit determination remain reliable at next-generation survey density?
Key_result: Simulation tests report low loss and false-identification rates under stated assumptions.
Innovation: Treats topocentric correction and quality control within a survey-scale workflow.
Limitation: Simulation results depend on cadence density and error assumptions.
Notes: Published title differs from shortened pasted title.

Title: Main-belt Comets in the Palomar Transient Factory Survey: I. The Search for Extendedness
Authors: Waszczak A; Ofek EO; Aharonson O; et al.
Journal: Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society
Sample_size: ~2 million observations of ~220000 known main-belt objects
Main_question: Can a transient survey recover moving objects and identify comet-like extension?
Key_result: Reports 626 new multi-night linked objects and calibrated extendedness detection efficiency.
Innovation: Connects moving-object processing with morphology-based activity screening.
Limitation: Not a general-purpose comparison of moving-object pipelines.
Notes: Retained as a pipeline implementation and active-asteroid bridge.

Title: Systematic Ranging and Late Warning Asteroid Impacts
Authors: Farnocchia D; Chesley SR; Micheli M
Method: Raster scan of range and range rate
Main_question: How can a newly discovered short arc be assessed for near-term impact risk?
Key_result: Maps observation-error probability into orbital and impact probabilities.
Innovation: Operationally focused scan of poorly constrained range dimensions.
Limitation: Results are sensitive to astrometry, error model and follow-up availability.

Title: The Atmospheric Impact Trajectory of Asteroid 2014 AA
Authors: Farnocchia D; Chesley SR; Brown PG; Chodas PW
Sample_size: Seven observations over 69 minutes plus infrasound
Main_question: How can a pre-impact short arc be constrained after atmospheric entry?
Key_result: Combines optical astrometry and infrasound to substantially reduce trajectory uncertainty.
Innovation: Real impactor case joining discovery observations to independent geophysical constraints.
Limitation: Single exceptional case; constraints unavailable for most discoveries.
Notes: 2014 AA was discovered about 21 hours before impact.

Title: HelioLinC: A Novel Approach to the Minor Planet Linking Problem
Authors: Holman MJ; Payne MJ; Blankley P; Janssen R; Kuindersma S
Main_question: Can multi-night tracklets be linked without cubic scaling?
Key_result: Reports O(N log N) scaling and about 41000 newly established minor-planet orbits.
Innovation: Clusters transformed tracklets at a common epoch.
Limitation: Completeness depends on trial orbit coverage and linking thresholds.
Notes: arXiv preprint title: Finding Asteroids Down the Back of the Couch.

Title: Short Arc Orbit Determination and Imminent Impactors in the Gaia Era
Authors: Spoto F; Del Vigna A; Milani A; et al.
Main_question: How can systematic ranging support short arcs and imminent-impactor assessment?
Key_result: Tests probability calculations on 2008 TC3 2014 AA and Gaia-observed objects.
Innovation: Open implementation-oriented extension to Gaia-era astrometry.
Limitation: Short arcs remain intrinsically degenerate without additional observations.
Notes: Use alongside Farnocchia 2015, not as an independent detection pipeline.

Title: Discovering Faint and High Apparent Motion Rate Near-Earth Asteroids Using a Deep Learning Program
Authors: Wang F; Ge J; Willis K
Journal: Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society
Main_question: Can a neural network recover faint high-rate NEO streaks?
Key_result: Reports six previously undiscovered asteroids in the searched ZTF data.
Innovation: Uses simulated streaks and multi-image cutouts in a full candidate pipeline.
Limitation: Performance beyond its simulated training and four-night test set requires validation.

Title: Survey-Wide Asteroid Discovery with a High-Performance Computing Enabled Non-Linear Digital Tracking Framework
Authors: Golovich N; Steil T; Geringer-Sameth A; et al.
Main_question: Can survey-wide non-linear trajectories be coadded to reveal much fainter moving objects?
Key_result: Demonstrates a high-performance framework for combining sparse observations along curved orbital paths.
Innovation: Extends digital tracking beyond short linear motion to survey-scale orbital curvature.
Limitation: Heavy computational cost and survey-scale completeness remain to be demonstrated.
Notes: Emerging-method record; avoid treating projected gains as established survey yield.

Title: The Potential of Sparse Photometric Data in Asteroid Shape Modeling
Main_question: When can sparse survey photometry yield a unique shape and spin solution?
Key_result: Derives unique models for a subset of control objects and documents reliability limits.
Innovation: Direct validation of sparse-only models against independently derived solutions.
Limitation: Works only for a selective subset with adequate geometry and amplitude.
Notes: Core evidence for sparse-data selection criteria.

Title: Asteroid Light Curves from the Palomar Transient Factory Survey: Rotation Periods and Phase Functions from Sparse Photometry
Authors: Waszczak A; Chang CK; Ofek EO; et al.
Main_question: How reliably can sparse single-opposition survey lightcurves yield periods and phase parameters?
Key_result: Reports 9033 reliable fitted lightcurves after reference-based reliability assessment.
Innovation: Combines physical fitting with a learned reliability screen.
Limitation: Period reliability varies strongly with amplitude magnitude and sampling.
Notes: Bridge from lightcurve extraction to validated population inference.

Title: Reconstruction of Asteroid Spin States from Gaia DR2 Photometry
Method: Convex inversion plus triaxial ellipsoid period search
Main_question: What spin-state information can Gaia DR2 sparse photometry recover?
Key_result: Compares Gaia-derived periods with dense-lightcurve results and identifies reliable solutions.
Innovation: Establishes a scalable Gaia-era inversion workflow with external validation.
Limitation: Sparse cadence yields aliases and requires stringent solution screening.
Notes: Precursor to Gaia DR3 population-scale inversion.

Title: Asteroid Models Reconstructed from the Lowell Photometric Database and WISE Data
Authors: Alí-Lagoa V; Ďurech J; Hanus J; et al.
Main_question: Can optical sparse photometry and thermal lightcurves jointly constrain asteroid models?
Key_result: Demonstrates joint reconstruction using survey archives with complementary wavelengths.
Innovation: Connects visible-light inversion to thermal constraints.
Limitation: Model quality remains limited by sparse geometry and photometric systematics.
Notes: Use in the multi-data inversion subsection.

Title: Asteroid Shape Inversion with Light Curves Using Deep Learning
Authors: Tang Y; Ying C; Xia C; et al.
Sample_size: Synthetic training plus two observational examples
Main_question: Can a learned mapping recover convex shape information from lightcurves?
Key_result: Reports validation on synthetic data and two Lowell-observed asteroids.
Innovation: Explores direct learned inversion and concavity prediction.
Limitation: Limited observational validation and training-domain transfer remain open.
Notes: Emerging method; compare against physics-based inversion on common tests.
